title: Hearty Crisp Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A sour and crisp Syrian dish featuring chicken bouillon powder and char-grill flavors, perfect for a comforting meal. This Mediterranean-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together chicken bouillon powder, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional sumac and lemon wedges if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
To reheat, simply grill or bake the kebabs until heated through.
